title: Edit Sales Orders in a Spreadsheet inside Business Central (Advanced Spreadsheets and Reporting)

chapters.title: Introduction to spreadsheet editing for sales orders
Opening sales order lines in spreadsheet
Working with spreadsheet regions and customer requirements
Real-time updates and calculations in spreadsheets

features.name: Open lines in spreadsheet
features.description: Action that allows users to open sales order lines in a connected spreadsheet region within Business Central. The spreadsheet maintains a direct connection to the underlying sales order data.
caveats: requires advanced spreadsheets and reporting app

features.name: Spreadsheet region connected to sales order
features.description: A green region in the spreadsheet that is directly connected to the sales order, allowing real-time synchronization between spreadsheet edits and the sales order data.

features.name: Real-time data synchronization
features.description: Changes made in the spreadsheet are immediately reflected in the underlying sales order. Calculations and totals update automatically as users edit line items.

features.name: Edit sales order configurations in spreadsheet
features.description: Enables users to handle complex sales order scenarios such as pricing calculations, item relationships, and customer-driven configuration changes directly within a spreadsheet interface.
